title: HMD namespace settings
description: Settings in <namespace>/.namespace.yaml. They are committed to Git with the namespace's pages.

title.description: Name readers see for the namespace, including as the static site title. Defaults to the namespace name.

description.description: Short summary shown in namespace lists, at most 255 characters.

public.description: Let anyone read every page and attachment in the namespace without signing in. Public never means editable by everyone.

index.description: One-segment page name that opens at /<namespace>/ and is the static site's homepage.

tree.description: Order of pages and folders in the sidebar and static export. Drag to reorder; folders start collapsed and the index page stays first.

skin.description: Skin shown to anonymous readers and in the static export. Signed-in users see their own skin.

palette.description: Colour palette shown to anonymous readers and in the static export. Empty uses the skin's own palette.

widgets.description: Sidebar widgets, in order. Leave empty for the built-in set.

template.description: Hidden page whose body every quick-created page starts from.

slug.description: Go template that names a quick-created page, such as {{.Now.Format "2006-01-02"}} for a daily journal. Enables Ctrl+J.

base_url.description: Absolute URL where the static site will be published, including any path prefix. Used to build sitemap.xml.

sitemap.description: Include sitemap.xml in the static export.

robots_allow.description: Search and AI bots allowed to crawl the static site. Every other bot is blocked in robots.txt.

links.description: External links in the static site's sidebar or top bar. Labels are link text, or tooltips for icon-only links; icons use Font Awesome classes such as fa-brands fa-github.
